segments.v: I want to talk about a video about kintsugi. Kintsugi is a Japanese art. People repair broken bowls with gold. I watched it on YouTube at home a few weeks ago. YouTube recommended it to me. The video was about an old craftsman in Japan. He repaired an old tea bowl. He used glue and gold powder. It took many days. The video was very slow and calm. At the end, he said broken things can be more beautiful because they have a history. I liked this video because it was beautiful and relaxing. It also taught me that mistakes are not always bad. I shared it with my friend and my aunt.
